name: mise-toolchain
description: Project toolchain versions and cross-worktree env layering via mise, for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: mise-based toolchain pinning and env layering
interface.longDescription: Skills for writing a project's mise.toml [tools] block by inheriting the machine's existing version preferences, and for layering a shared baseline .env across git worktrees through mise.local.toml.
defaultPrompt: Pin this project's toolchain versions with mise.
Let this worktree reuse the shared baseline .env.
